description: Get the insider transactions filed on SEDI, Canada's insider disclosure system, for the issuer of one Canadian listing, written MIC:TICKER (e.g. XTSE:ATD, XTSX:..., XCNQ:..., NEOE:...), newest first. Each row gives the transaction date, the insider and their relationship to the issuer, the registered holder for indirect holdings, the SEDI transaction type, the security (options, share units and warrants included, with the underlying where filed), the signed amount (negative for a disposition) in units of that security, the price and its currency, the holding after the transaction and the filing date. An amended transaction appears once, at its newest amendment. Capture began with about the year before it first ran and grows daily, so older history is missing. For US Form 4 filings use GetInsiderTransactions; for European director dealings use GetEuropeanDirectorTransactions.

ticker.description: Canadian listing symbol MIC:TICKER, e.g. XTSE:ATD. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's Canadian listings to ask with.
